Authored road endpoints 39.20/42.75 m follow the primary longitudinal section; independent BD TOPO 3D motorway elevations corroborate the elevated approaches within their stated 2.5 m vertical accuracy. Directed five-arch alignment and curved bank wings were reviewed in all four current production terrain frames. With the model origin at 27.40 m NGF-IGN69, road endpoints are approximately 35.45/35.56 m, agreeing with independent upper-bank samples 35.4/35.6 m and the official BD TOPO 3D road within its stated 1.5 m vertical accuracy. Rays 0.5 m inside the modeled ends retain 0.62/0.41 m residuals because the 3 m terrain grid interpolates the sharp quay edge; no terrain fitting or flattening was applied. All five openings remain visible and the banks support the modeled ends. Represented normal water 28.50 m differs from the preserved RGE ALTI water surface 28.05 m by 0.45 m; these are different water/reference states, not a measured datum conversion. Host terrain must use NGF-IGN69 or explicitly convert heights. Underwater footings remain a reconstruction, not a bathymetric survey. Current production captures additionally include the independent BD TOPO bridge and bank-road plans: only bridge-tagged covered fragments disappear, both road approaches meet the modeled ends, and lower quay roads remain visible under the outer arches. The native 166-point wing/deck outline is exact; connector stations approximate asymmetric endpoint locations by 2.65 m with less than 5 cm native profile difference. Current crowned-sidewalk mesh reviewed after longitudinal tessellation repair; all four frames in this report inspected.

Directed exact bridge footprint, north-island end and southern approach flare reviewed in eight current production terrain frames, including independently mapped road plans through the procedural renderer. The 26.96 m NGF-IGN69 origin preserves the independent terrain water reference. Northern upper-bank road samples at native X 40–44 m are 34.58–34.60 m versus modeled endpoint approximately 34.60 m; the southern road meets the 34.1–34.4 m plateau with a roughly 0.4 m local residual. The old X 33.1 m ray hits a smoothed quay face at 31.97 m, so its 2.62 m clearance is retained rather than mistaken for an upper-road mismatch. Loaded-model polygon replacement removes covered bridge road fragments, connects both approaches and preserves the lower quay road. BD TOPO road widths remain narrower than the authored deck; independent source Z has stated 1.5 m accuracy and is not used to flatten the model or terrain. Hosts must supply compatible NGF-IGN69 heights or an explicit datum conversion. Submerged footing depth is a reconstruction, not bathymetry.
